## MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
CAUTION — low volatility environment (Vol: 19.6%) with narrow participation (Breadth: 2/8 sectors positive), signalling stock-specific rallies rather than broad risk-on.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Construction & REIT ABOVE TREND: TKFEN (1W: +31.28% | 1M: +76.98%); Holding & Investment ABOVE TREND: DOHOL (1W: +2.28% | 1M: +1.79%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Retail & Food BELOW TREND: MGROS (1W: -9.35% | 1M: -8.55%); Transportation BELOW TREND: THYAO (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -10.38%); Heavy Industry BELOW TREND: EREGL (1W: -11.43% | 1M: -7.97%).

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

TKFEN (1W: +31.28% | 1M: +76.98%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: +15.64% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND; ASELS (1W: +9.88% | 1M: +2.97%) ABOVE TREND; OYAKC (1W: +6.22% | 1M: +6.53%) ABOVE TREND; TTKOM (1W: +5.62% | 1M: -2.84%) RECOVERY.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
EREGL (1W: -11.43% | 1M: -7.97%) BELOW TREND; MGROS (1W: -9.35% | 1M: -8.55%) BELOW TREND; AEFES (1W: -8.44% | 1M: -4.59%) BELOW TREND; PETKM (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND; HALKB (1W: -7.71% | 1M: -14.91%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
TKFEN (1W: +31.28% | 1M: +76.98%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: +15.64% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND; ASELS (1W: +9.88% | 1M: +2.97%) ABOVE TREND; EREGL (1W: -11.43% | 1M: -7.97%) BELOW TREND; MGROS (1W: -9.35% | 1M: -8.55%) BELOW TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Mixed and defensive; AKBNK (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +0.07%) ABOVE TREND, GARAN (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +1.55%) ABOVE TREND, ISCTR (1W: +1.78% | 1M: -8.85%) RECOVERY, HALKB (1W: -7.71% | 1M: -14.91%) BELOW TREND — prefer quality large caps, avoid weak balance-sheet names.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Divergent: ASELS (1W: +9.88% | 1M: +2.97%) ABOVE TREND and TOASO (1W: +2.09% | 1M: -11.40%) RECOVERY vs EREGL (1W: -11.43% | 1M: -7.97%) BELOW TREND and KRDMD (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +8.36%) CORRECTION — trade stock-specific catalysts.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Rotation within the group: TUPRS (1W: +15.64% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND and OYAKC (1W: +6.22% | 1M: +6.53%) ABOVE TREND, but PETKM (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND and SISE (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -5.71%) BELOW TREND — favor names benefiting from commodity tailwinds.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Under CAUTION: trim broad beta, take profits on stretched winners (TKFEN, TUPRS), reallocate into selective leaders and names with clear catalysts (ASELS, AKBNK, DOHOL) while keeping cash for volatility-driven opportunities.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
TKFEN (1W: +31.28% | 1M: +76.98%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: +15.64% | 1M: +31.55%) ABOVE TREND; ASELS (1W: +9.88% | 1M: +2.97%) ABOVE TREND; ISCTR (1W: +1.78% | 1M: -8.85%) RECOVERY.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Construction & REIT for momentum continuation; Energy & Chemicals for commodity-driven moves; Banking for sensitivity to lira and policy headlines.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch XU100 reaction around the 20-day MA and recent swing highs/lows for confirmation of broad participation; key triggers are CBT policy/comments, USD/TRY moves, Brent oil swings and company-specific earnings or cost updates.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
CAUTION regime: low volatility but very narrow breadth — market rallies are stock-specific not broad-based. Opportunities concentrated in Construction & REIT and select Energy names (TKFEN, TUPRS, ASELS); primary risk is a breadth-driven reversal that penalizes stretched winners and weak retail/transportation names.
